_comment: F52 W3-4 doctor manifest, discovered BY CONVENTION at {adapter-skill}/tools/doctor-manifest.json
— deliberately NOT a named ADR-60 adapter capability (the capability contract pins exactly five,
in order, parsed from literal headings in all four adapters).
Fix hints CITE the prose runbooks in this skill's SKILL.md; they do not replace them.
Run: tools/doctor.mjs from the base directory the loaded mine-verify-cover skill announced, with --skill {this-skill-dir}

checks.name: .NET SDK present
checks.fixHint: install the .NET SDK — the Cover arm cannot build or run the mined test project without it

checks.name: Stryker.NET dotnet-tool available
checks.fixHint: dotnet tool install -g dotnet-stryker (or restore the local tool manifest) — Stryker is capability 3, the mutation tool

_not_probed: The test-project scaffold is deliberately NOT a check here. Doctor v1 probes the ENVIRONMENT and
takes no target-repo path, so any 'is the test project scaffolded' probe it could run would pass
wherever the SDK exists — a check that cannot fail is no check, which is the exact vacuity this
wave exists to remove. The scaffold stays an operator prerequisite in the prose runbook, and the
Stryker fix hint above points at it.
